intro: I'm a Computing (AI) and Economics student at Queen's and an AI Engineer at QMIND, building AI-powered software and data tools that cut manual work. This past summer I was a Data Analyst Intern in BMO's Corporate Audit group (Audit AI and Analytics), where I built an automated audit-testing pipeline in Python on AWS SageMaker and an AWS Bedrock LLM workflow that turned a manual procedure into a reproducible service. The summer before, at BMC, I built Qubotix, a test automation dashboard that generates and runs tests with LangChain and Playwright.

On my own time I build the projects below: a lecture library that won its track at KingHacks 2026, a clinic intake app that works in four languages, and two NLP projects on tweets. If you want to talk about any of it, please email me.

bullets: Building a multi-agent harness with WSP to generate engineering diagrams.

experience.role: Data Analyst Intern, Corporate Audit (Audit AI & Analytics)
bullets: Built an automated audit-testing pipeline in Python on AWS SageMaker, cutting auditors' manual review time by 65%.

Implemented an AWS Bedrock LLM workflow that turned a manual audit procedure into a reproducible service with fixed prompt templates, reducing preparation and validation effort by 50%; 95% of outputs agreed with auditors' conclusions.
Automated a multi-stage approval workflow in Power Apps, Power Automate, and SharePoint for a prompt library, saving 5 hours of approval time per item.
Orchestrated LLM-driven test script generation with LangChain for BMC Qubotix; 85% of 120 generated scripts ran green without edits.
Integrated Playwright to execute generated scripts automatically, enabling continuous, hands-off validation of AI-generated tests.
Built the full stack of the Qubotix dashboard: a React/TypeScript frontend and Node.js/Flask REST APIs that show script changes and pass/fail rates live.

projects.title: QU Lecture Library
projects.subtitle: Lecture recordings to searchable study material. KingHacks 2026 track winner.
description: Students upload lecture recordings by course code, then search their course to find any lecture with its AI-generated notes, flashcards and quizzes in one place. The backend is a Fastify REST API with Prisma/SQLite and Zod validation, documented in OpenAPI, behind a React/Vite/Tailwind frontend.

The upload-to-notes pipeline runs ElevenLabs speech-to-text for timestamped transcripts, then an OpenAI note generator via Python/LangChain, with an end-to-end smoke test. Built with a team of 4 and tested end to end on 40 lectures.

projects.title: Doctor AI Summary
projects.subtitle: Multilingual clinic intake with an AI-organized summary for the doctor.
description: Patients answer on a phone or tablet in English, French, Punjabi or Hindi. The doctor sees an AI-organized English summary beside every original answer, with its translation.

Summary and translation run as separate temperature-0 model calls (Gemini or Claude), with an automated check that flags any medication or number missing from the summary. Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), auto-deleted after 24 hours, and covered by 10 automated tests.

projects.title: BERTopic Company Tweet Sentiment & Topic Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Topic modelling and sentiment for company-related tweets.
description: An NLP pipeline using BERTopic and transformer-based sentiment analysis to find the main topics and sentiment trends in company-related tweets. It turns noisy social media text into interpretable topic clusters.

screenshots.alt: Pie and bar chart of tweet sentiment: 1189 neutral, 535 negative, 280 positive

projects.title: DistilBERT Disaster Tweet Classifier
projects.subtitle: Real disaster reports versus everything else. Kaggle NLP competition.
description: Fine-tuned DistilBERT (67M parameters) on 7,613 labelled tweets, reaching 81.5% accuracy and 0.81 weighted F1 on 1,142 held-out tweets, against a TF-IDF + logistic regression baseline of 79%.
A confusion matrix and per-class analysis showed 0.76 recall on the minority class was the dominant failure, and the train/validation loss gap pointed to overfitting.
